summary: Product lead at Deloitte Digital since 2019. I've taken client programs in loyalty, retail data, consent and healthcare from discovery to launch. Now I also build products with AI, and help client teams bring AI into how they plan, build and test software.

experience.title: Product, client delivery programs
bullets: Delivered loyalty platforms for a national airline and a national grocer, from discovery through launch.
Led product on a grocer's data transformation, and on consent capture that meets Canadian privacy and anti-spam law.
Product lead on a healthcare workforce-management transformation used by schedulers across a hospital network.
Technical program manager for internal real-estate software, using AI to turn meetings into executive updates and to drive follow-ups, delivering every initiative on time.
Helps clients bring AI into software delivery: finding where it changes the work, choosing the tools and piloting new ways of working with their teams.
Finds new opportunities with clients, writes proposals and keeps the relationships that lead to follow-on work.
Co-wrote the practice's product delivery and product strategy guides, used to onboard other practitioners.

bullets: Built a library of IoT, blockchain and RPA use cases from the firm's past engagements, with teaching materials so practitioners could reuse them on new work.
